body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two detected enemies within 4 units and 2 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each suffers -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn. Choose one hit target to take 1 Psychic Damage.

surges.html: One hit target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
Deal 1 Psychic Damage to the second hit target as well.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Phantom
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Phantom Full Manifestation (FM-1P). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
